bullets.text: Sage Launches Video Series - A new short-form video series aims to simplify understanding of **AI Agents** for users.
Accountants Embrace AI - UK accountants are shifting from curiosity to confident experimentation with **AI** tools.
MTD Deadline Approaches - **Making Tax Digital** for Income Tax starts in April 2026, requiring digital record-keeping.
E-Invoicing Boosts SMEs - **E-invoicing** can significantly improve cash flow and reduce administrative burdens for small businesses.
Sage's Sustainability Recognition - **Sage** has been acknowledged in three prestigious lists for its culture and sustainability efforts.
